content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same issue with a [product_name] device. After powering it on for approximately 30 minutes, if I turn off and then back on the device, the clock settings are lost.

The real time clock uses a SuperCap as a buffer and may require more time during its initial charge to function properly. Powering the [product_name] for only 30 minutes might not be enough; try leaving it powered for a longer period to allow the buffer to fully charge.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the real time clock settings on their [product_name] devices are lost after turning the device off and on, even after having it powered for 30 minutes. There is uncertainty about how long the device needs to be powered in order for the SuperCap buffer to fully charge, which is necessary for reliable clock retention. This has caused concern regarding the reliability of the RTC feature.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the real time clock settings to remain after a normal power cycle, especially after initial setup. They also hope to find clear documentation or guidance on the required power-on duration to ensure proper retention of clock settings.
